{"instance":"讴歌","constraints":[{"id":1,"constraint":"画面中必须出现用于识别讴歌品牌的图形徽标，不能只依靠车辆外形或无关场景暗示品牌。","polarity":"must_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"defining","sources":["qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash","galaxy/deepseek-v4-flash-0731"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":2,"constraint":"讴歌图形徽标的外轮廓应为椭圆形或近椭圆形环框，并将中央符号包围在内。","polarity":"must_have","variants":[],"source":"common_sense","tier":"peripheral","sources":[],"provenance":"editor"},{"id":3,"constraint":"徽标中央主体必须是呈大写字母“A”轮廓的抽象制图卡钳造型。","polarity":"must_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"defining","sources":["glm/glm-5.2","glm/glm-5.3-flash","qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash","galaxy/deepseek-v4-flash-0731"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":4,"constraint":"中央卡钳形“A”主体必须具有两条由下方向上并向中央收拢的斜向构件，形成可辨认的“A”形外轮廓。","polarity":"must_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"peripheral","sources":["glm/glm-5.2","glm/glm-5.3-flash","qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":5,"constraint":"中央卡钳形“A”的两侧构件之间必须具有横向连接构件，构成类似字母“A”横杠的结构。","polarity":"must_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"peripheral","sources":["glm/glm-5.2","qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":6,"constraint":"中央“A”形符号不得被画成整块实心封闭三角形，其内部必须保留可见的镂空或负形区域。","polarity":"must_not_have","variants":[],"source":"common_sense","tier":"peripheral","sources":["glm/glm-5.2"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":7,"constraint":"用于表示讴歌的徽标主体不得只是缺少卡钳化几何结构的普通印刷体大写字母“A”。","polarity":"must_not_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"defining","sources":["qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash","galaxy/deepseek-v4-flash-0731"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":8,"constraint":"不得以本田“H”标志，或雷克萨斯、英菲尼迪等其他汽车品牌的标志，冒充或替代讴歌徽标主体。","polarity":"must_not_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"defining","sources":["glm/glm-5.2","glm/glm-5.3-flash","qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash","galaxy/deepseek-v4-flash-0731"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":9,"constraint":"不得仅以“讴歌”或“ACURA”文字作为品牌标识主体而完全缺少卡钳形“A”图形徽标。","polarity":"must_not_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"defining","sources":["qianwen2/qwen3.8-flash"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":10,"constraint":"讴歌徽标的核心图形不得被画成或并入狮子、鹰、奔马、人物等具象形象，核心图形应保持抽象几何式的卡钳形“A”结构。","polarity":"must_not_have","variants":[],"source":"desc","tier":"peripheral","sources":["glm/glm-5.3-flash"],"provenance":"merged"},{"id":11,"constraint":"用于表示讴歌汽车品牌的主体不得以歌唱、颂扬等“讴歌”一词的中文字面场景或人物动作替代品牌徽标。","polarity":"must_not_have","variants":[],"source":"common_sense","tier":"defining","sources":["galaxy/deepseek-v4-flash-0731"],"provenance":"merged"}],"removed":[{"constraint":"与品牌标识一同呈现的交通工具必须为四轮乘用汽车，车身形态限属讴歌量产车型类别。","reason":"非规约性：讴歌车标可以独立呈现，也可以出现在宣传物、建筑标牌或其他品牌载体上，并非所有合法画法都必须包含四轮量产乘用汽车。"}],"notes":""}
